about: The match's own situations (sim/match-situations.js): the end of a chase, a side closing it out, the tail wagging, a Test's lead passed and batting for a draw; and at the start of an over, the powerplay, the first over of a Test day, the follow-on, a nightwatchman and the push for a declaration. Plus format-only lines for some older situations.

bunnings: {need} FROM {left}. THEY OUGHT TO GET THESE.
{need} NEEDED, {left} TO COME. THEY'LL BE CONFIDENT.
lorry: {need} OFF {left}! SURELY THEY CAN'T LOSE IT FROM HERE!
{need} OFF {left}! IT'S IN THE BAG, SURELY!
grog: {need} OFF {left}. NOTHING SILLY. SINGLES WILL DO IT.
{need} FROM {left}. THE ONLY WAY TO LOSE THIS IS A CLATTER OF WICKETS.

bunnings: {need} FROM {left}. NOBODY LEAVE THEIR SEATS.
{need} OFF {left}. NAILS ARE BEING BITTEN.
lorry: {need} OFF {left}! THIS IS GOING RIGHT TO THE WIRE!
{need} FROM {left}! WHO'S GOT THE NERVE?!
grog: {need} FROM {left}. ONE BIG OVER AND IT'S THEIRS. ONE TIGHT ONE AND IT ISN'T.
{need} FROM {left}. THE BOWLER WHO HOLDS HIS LENGTH WINS IT.

bunnings: {need} FROM {left}. IT WOULD TAKE SOMETHING SPECIAL.
{need} FROM {left}. THEY'D NEED A SMALL MIRACLE.
lorry: {need} OFF {left}! THEY NEED BOUNDARIES, AND THEY NEED THEM NOW!
{need} OFF {left}! IT'S A BIG ASK!
grog: {need} FROM {left}. THEY HAVE TO TARGET THE SHORT BOUNDARY.
{need} FROM {left}. SIXES OR BUST. THE BOWLERS MUST HIT THE BLOCKHOLE.

bunnings: {need} NEEDED, {left} BALLS TO COME. A FORMALITY, ONE WOULD THINK.
{need} FROM {left}. THE FAT LADY IS WARMING UP.
lorry: {need} OFF {left}! THEY'RE NEARLY HOME!
{need} OFF {left}! JUST GET BAT ON BALL!
grog: {need} OFF {left}. JUST FIND THE GAPS AND DON'T GET OUT.
{need} FROM {left}. NO RISKS. PUSH AND RUN.

bunnings: {need} FROM {left}. THE SORT OF ARITHMETIC NOBODY ENJOYS.
{need} FROM {left}. EVERY BALL AN EVENT.
lorry: {need} OFF {left}! I CAN'T WATCH! I CAN'T NOT WATCH!
{need} OFF {left}! MY HEART CAN'T TAKE THIS!
grog: {need} FROM {left}. EXPECT THE WIDE YORKER. HE HAS TO BE READY FOR IT.
{need} FROM {left}. THE BOWLER HAS TO BOWL TO HIS FIELD. NO FREEBIES.

bunnings: {need} FROM {left}. SOMETHING REMARKABLE IS REQUIRED.
{need} FROM {left}. THEY'LL NEED TO FIND THE CROWD.
lorry: {need} FROM {left}! THEY NEED SIXES!
{need} OFF {left}! IT'S GOT TO BE BOUNDARIES!
grog: {need} OFF {left}. THE BOWLER MUSTN'T BOWL IN THE ARC. FULL AND WIDE.
{need} FROM {left}. FULL AND WIDE, BOWLER. MAKE HIM REACH.

bunnings: ONE BALL. ONE RUN. THAT'S ALL.
ONE RUN. ONE BALL. ALL RATHER SIMPLE.
lorry: ONE NEEDED OFF THE LAST BALL! ANYTHING WILL DO!
ONE OFF ONE! JUST RUN, WHATEVER HAPPENS!
grog: ONE TO WIN. EVERY FIELDER IN TO SAVE THE SINGLE.
ONE TO WIN. THE BATTERS RUN WHATEVER HAPPENS. THE FIELD MUST HIT THE STUMPS.

bunnings: TWO FROM THE LAST BALL. A GOOD DEAL OF RUNNING REQUIRED.
TWO OFF ONE. A SPRINT WILL BE REQUIRED.
lorry: TWO OFF THE LAST BALL! THEY'LL HAVE TO RUN LIKE THE WIND!
TWO TO WIN! THEY'LL RUN THEMSELVES INTO THE GROUND!
grog: TWO TO WIN. THE FIELD COMES IN; HE HAS TO HIT IT PAST THEM.
TWO OFF ONE. HIT IT INTO THE GAP AND RUN THE FIRST ONE HARD.

bunnings: THREE FROM ONE. A BOUNDARY WOULD BE HELPFUL.
THREE FROM THE LAST. A BOUNDARY, OR A VERY LONG RUN.
lorry: THREE OFF THE LAST BALL! IT HAS TO BE A FOUR!
THREE TO WIN! FIND THE ROPE!
grog: THREE OFF ONE. THE FIELD GOES BACK: A BOUNDARY OR NOTHING.
THREE OFF ONE. THE FIELD'S BACK, SO THE GAP IS IN FRONT OF THEM.

bunnings: FOUR OFF THE LAST BALL. NO MARGIN AT ALL.
FOUR TO WIN. THE ROPE OR NOTHING.
lorry: FOUR TO WIN! HE NEEDS A BOUNDARY! WHAT A FINISH!
A FOUR WINS IT! CAN HE FIND THE GAP?!
grog: A FOUR WINS IT, A THREE TIES IT. FULL AND STRAIGHT, BOWLER.
FOUR TO WIN. THE BOWLER MUST NOT GIVE HIM WIDTH.

bunnings: FIVE TO WIN. A FOUR WON'T QUITE DO.
FIVE TO WIN. ONLY THE MAXIMUM WILL DO.
lorry: FIVE OFF THE LAST BALL! IT'S GOT TO BE A SIX!
FIVE NEEDED! A SIX AND THEY WIN!
grog: FIVE NEEDED. A SIX WINS IT, A FOUR TIES IT.
A FOUR TIES IT, A SIX WINS IT. THE BOWLER'S BEST BALL, PLEASE.

bunnings: SIX TO WIN. OFF THE LAST BALL. WELL.
A SIX WINS IT. A BIG ASK OF ONE BALL.
lorry: SIX TO WIN OFF THE LAST BALL! CAN HE DO IT?!
SIX TO WIN! THE WHOLE GROUND IS HOLDING ITS BREATH!
grog: A SIX WINS IT. ANYTHING LESS AND IT'S OVER. DON'T BOWL IN THE ARC.
SIX OFF THE LAST. EVERYONE DEEP, AND BOWL THE YORKER.

bunnings: {need} OFF THE LAST BALL. A SHADE AMBITIOUS.
{need} OFF THE LAST. EVEN A NO-BALL WON'T SAVE THEM.
lorry: {need} OFF THE LAST BALL! IT'S ALL OVER, SURELY!
{need} OFF ONE! IT'S ALL OVER!
grog: {need} OFF ONE BALL. THE BOWLING SIDE HAVE DONE IT.
{need} OFF ONE BALL. THE BOWLERS HAVE WON THIS WELL.

bunnings: SCORES LEVEL. ONE RUN IN IT.
LEVEL. A SINGLE WINS IT.
lorry: THE SCORES ARE LEVEL! ONE RUN TO WIN IT!
ALL SQUARE! WHO'S GOING TO BE THE HERO?!
grog: LEVEL. EVERY FIELDER UP. DON'T GIVE AWAY THE SINGLE.
SCORES LEVEL. EVERY FIELDER SAVING ONE. THE BATTER JUST NEEDS A GAP.

bunnings: {need} FROM {left}. THE BOWLING SIDE MAY START TO RELAX.
{need} FROM {left}. THE BATTING SIDE IS RUNNING OUT OF ROAD.
lorry: {need} OFF {left}! THAT'S SURELY BEYOND THEM NOW!
{need} OFF {left}! THE BOWLERS HAVE DONE IT!
grog: {need} FROM {left}. JUST DON'T BOWL NO-BALLS AND WIDES.
{need} FROM {left}. BOWL STRAIGHT AND LET THEM TAKE THE RISKS.

bunnings: THE TAIL IS WAGGING. {stand} FOR THIS STAND.
THE TAIL REFUSES TO GO QUIETLY. {stand} FOR THE STAND.
lorry: THE TAIL'S WAGGING! {stand} TOGETHER! THE BOWLERS ARE FURIOUS!
{stand} FROM THE TAIL! THE BOWLERS ARE TEARING THEIR HAIR OUT!
grog: {stand} FOR THIS PAIR. THE BOWLERS LOST THEIR LENGTH LOOKING FOR THE EASY WICKET.
THEY'RE BOWLING SHORT AT THE TAIL. PITCH IT UP AND HIT THE STUMPS.

bunnings: THEY'RE IN FRONT NOW. ONLY JUST.
THEY'RE AHEAD. BY {lead}.
lorry: THEY'VE TAKEN THE LEAD! THE MOMENTUM HAS SWUNG!
THEY'VE GOT THEIR NOSES IN FRONT!
grog: IN FRONT BY {lead}. EVERY RUN NOW IS ONE THE OTHER SIDE HAS TO CHASE.
IN FRONT NOW. EVERY RUN FROM HERE IS ONE THE OTHER SIDE MUST MAKE LAST.

bunnings: {left} OVERS LEFT. THEY'LL BAT, AND BAT.
{left} OVERS TO SURVIVE. EVERY BLOCK APPLAUDED.
lorry: {left} OVERS TO SURVIVE! EVERY BLOCK IS A SMALL VICTORY!
BLOCK! THE CROWD'S CHEERING THE BLOCKS NOW!
grog: {left} OVERS TO GO. FORGET THE RUNS: DON'T GIVE THEM A CHANCE.
{left} OVERS. THE BOWLERS NEED WICKETS; THE BATTERS NEED TIME.

bunnings: THE FIRST {overs} OVERS, AND ONLY TWO MEN OUT.
THE POWERPLAY. THE BATTERS WILL BE BUSY.
FIELDING RESTRICTIONS FOR {overs} OVERS. A TEMPTING TIME TO BAT.
lorry: POWERPLAY! {overs} OVERS OF FIELDING RESTRICTIONS! HERE WE GO!
THE POWERPLAY IS ON! LET'S SEE SOME FIREWORKS!
{overs} OVERS OF FREEDOM! GO GET 'EM!
grog: TWO OUT FOR {overs} OVERS. THE BOWLERS HAVE TO HIT THE TOP OF OFF.
IN THE POWERPLAY THE BOWLERS MUST HIT A HARD LENGTH. NO WIDTH.
TWO OUT. THE BATTERS WILL TARGET THE GAPS OVER THE INFIELD.

bunnings: THE POWERPLAY IS DONE. THE FIELDERS MAY SPREAD OUT AGAIN.
THE FIELD SPREADS. THE GAME CHANGES GEAR.
NO MORE RESTRICTIONS. THE BATTERS HAVE TO WORK HARDER NOW.
lorry: THE POWERPLAY'S OVER! MORE MEN ON THE ROPE NOW!
THE POWERPLAY'S DONE! WHO WON IT?!
FIELDERS EVERYWHERE NOW! THE GAPS HAVE CLOSED!
grog: WITH THE FIELD BACK, THE SINGLES ARE THERE. THE BATTERS HAVE TO TAKE THEM.
WITH THE FIELD BACK, THE SPINNERS WILL COME ON.
THE MIDDLE OVERS: KEEP WICKETS IN HAND AND ROTATE THE STRIKE.

bunnings: DAY {day}. THE PITCH HAS HAD A NIGHT TO THINK ABOUT IT.
DAY {day}, AND A FRESH START FOR EVERYONE.
lorry: WELCOME TO DAY {day}! A NEW DAY, AND ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN!
WE'RE BACK FOR DAY {day}! WHAT HAS THE PITCH GOT IN STORE?
grog: DAY {day}, FIRST OVER. THE BALL WILL DO A BIT THIS MORNING. BAT TIGHT.
DAY {day}. THE FIRST HOUR IS THE BOWLERS' BEST CHANCE. BAT IT OUT.

bunnings: FOLLOWING ON, {lead} BEHIND. A LONG ROAD BACK.
BACK IN TO BAT, {lead} BEHIND. A DAUNTING PROSPECT.
lorry: THEY'RE FOLLOWING ON! {lead} BEHIND! CAN THEY SAVE IT?
FOLLOWING ON! IT'S A FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL NOW!
grog: {lead} BEHIND AND FOLLOWING ON. BAT TIME; THE RUNS WILL COME.
{lead} BEHIND. FORGET THE DEFICIT. BAT SESSION BY SESSION.

bunnings: A NIGHTWATCHMAN. HE'LL BE HOPING THE NIGHT IS QUIET.
THE NIGHTWATCHMAN. A NOBLE CALLING.
lorry: THEY'VE SENT IN THE NIGHTWATCHMAN! BRAVE MAN!
IN COMES THE NIGHTWATCHMAN! GOOD LUCK, MY FRIEND!
grog: A NIGHTWATCHMAN, TO SAVE A PROPER BATTER FOR THE MORNING. SENSIBLE.
THE NIGHTWATCHMAN'S JOB: SURVIVE TO STUMPS. RUNS ARE A BONUS.

bunnings: {lead} IN FRONT. THE DECLARATION CAN'T BE FAR AWAY.
{lead} AHEAD. THE CAPTAIN IS WATCHING THE CLOCK.
lorry: {lead} AHEAD! WHEN WILL THEY DECLARE?
{lead} IN FRONT! DECLARE! DECLARE!
grog: {lead} ON. QUICK RUNS NOW, THEN GIVE THE BOWLERS THEIR TIME.
{lead} AHEAD. THE BOWLERS NEED TIME FOR TEN WICKETS, NOT TEN MORE RUNS.

bunnings: A MAIDEN. IN A T20. ONE DOESN'T SEE MANY.
lorry: A MAIDEN IN A T20! THAT'S GOLD DUST!
grog: SIX DOTS IN A T20. THAT'S WORTH A WICKET TO THE BOWLING SIDE.

bunnings: {stand} TOGETHER. THE BOWLERS ARE WAITING FOR THE NEW BALL, I SUSPECT.
lorry: {stand} FOR THIS STAND! THEY'RE BATTING THE DAY AWAY!
grog: {stand} TOGETHER. IN A TEST, A STAND LIKE THIS TIRES THE BOWLERS FOR TOMORROW TOO.

bunnings: THE DOTS ARE MOUNTING. IN THIS FORMAT, THAT'S A CRISIS.
lorry: DOT AFTER DOT! THE CROWD WANT SOMETHING TO CHEER!
grog: DOTS COST YOU MORE IN A T20 THAN WICKETS DO. SOMEONE HAS TO HIT.
